kan11-CEOoF2BUKvk:en.title: All Mothers Lie
kan11-CEOoF2BUKvk:en.overview: All Mothers Lie is an Israeli comedy-drama series created by Yael Katz, Noam Nevo and Natalie Michaelashvili-Dror, directed by Atara Frish. The series is a sports drama produced by Green Productions and United King Films. The plot centers on a single mother who decides to embark on a sporting journey and play basketball, in an attempt to positively influence her son's life and get him out of his sedentary lifestyle.

kan11-yaY-3H2JN_c:en.title: Yekumot
kan11-yaY-3H2JN_c:en.overview:
“Yekumot” is a dramedy series created by Roy Kafri and Gon Ben Ari.

Each episode consists of sketches centered around a specific theme. The series blends absurdity and even fantasy with darker topics such as grief or existential anxiety.

kan11-7BUtLEyeb8E:en.title: Chasing Raine
kan11-7BUtLEyeb8E:en.overview: Two elite soldiers; a mother and a father race against time to rescue their daughter from the clutches of a ruthless child trafficking syndicate , as they navigate through a treacherous labyrinth of danger and deceit. They must confront their own past traumas while shredding through a brutal underworld that thrives in secrecy.

kan11-iFmLiBmEbu8:en.title: The War After
kan11-iFmLiBmEbu8:en.overview: A story of an army colonel who is fighting the accusations in committing war crime but his only witness is comatose in the hospital.

kan11-0mRdi_Ivx-0:en.title: Whatever You Say
kan11-0mRdi_Ivx-0:en.overview: Comedians and other thinkers will interpret and tell about the last week that has passed for all of us in the Israeli and global reality.

kan11-sm4Eo3jQn9g:en.title: Carthago
kan11-sm4Eo3jQn9g:en.overview: Elijah Levi, a successful comedian in 1942 Palestine, is deported by the British authorities to Carthago, a detainee camp, in which he is held with Jewish underground warriors and Nazi criminals.

e24b8626-80a5-473e-bfa4-290a099f438b:en.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
e24b8626-80a5-473e-bfa4-290a099f438b:en.overview: Ten years after the events of the original, a reprogrammed T-800 is sent back in time to protect young John Connor from the shape-shifting T-1000. Together with his mother Sarah, he fights to stop Skynet from triggering a nuclear apocalypse.

f3423a5f-2932-4ae8-9ae7-dd12297abcec:en.title: Terminator Genisys
f3423a5f-2932-4ae8-9ae7-dd12297abcec:en.overview: The year is 2029. John Connor, leader of the resistance continues the war against the machines. At the Los Angeles offensive, John's fears of the unknown future begin to emerge when TECOM spies reveal a new plot by SkyNet that will attack him from both fronts; past and future, and will ultimately change warfare forever.

5e14b57b-0460-4f2e-935f-f3e6ceac15f1:en.title: Ice Cream Man
5e14b57b-0460-4f2e-935f-f3e6ceac15f1:en.overview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

4910edaf-b0d3-4bc6-9d05-8cbd6bd41e88:en.title: Seed of Chucky
4910edaf-b0d3-4bc6-9d05-8cbd6bd41e88:en.overview: This time around, Chucky and his homicidal honey, Tiffany, are brought back to life by their orphan offspring, Glen. Then the horror goes Hollywood as Chucky unleashes his own brand of murderous mayhem!

3a1efc9e-50f7-4536-860c-63ed32ad51ee:en.title: Bride of Chucky
3a1efc9e-50f7-4536-860c-63ed32ad51ee:en.overview: For ten years, the tortured soul of serial killer Charles Lee Ray has been imprisoned inside a child's doll. Chucky is reborn when his old flame, Tiffany, rescues his battered doll parts from a police impound. But Chucky wants his new playmate cut down to size, so he transforms his blushing bride into a stunning little terror. Chucky and Tiffany can't wait to start their own homicidal honeymoon. When this demonic duo hits the road and hooks up with a pair of unsuspecting newlyweds, they leave a trail of murder and mayhem behind them. Chucky's back!

e31777ca-9b9c-4b32-9fe0-098c38d2213e:en.title: Child's Play 2
e31777ca-9b9c-4b32-9fe0-098c38d2213e:en.overview: Chucky is reconstructed by a toy factory to dispel the negative publicity surrounding the doll, and tracks young Andy Barclay to a foster home where the chase begins again.

8a009691-5d4a-4b13-b2a9-ac0345d0350d:en.title: Cult of Chucky
8a009691-5d4a-4b13-b2a9-ac0345d0350d:en.overview: Confined to an asylum for the criminally insane for the past four years, Nica is wrongly convinced that she, not Chucky, murdered her entire family... until a string of grisly deaths occur after her psychiatrist introduces a new group therapy tool -- a "Good Guy" doll.

c3866a3e-0e0f-4e39-9399-bba8357f583b:en.title: Child's Play 3
c3866a3e-0e0f-4e39-9399-bba8357f583b:en.overview: Eight years after seemingly destroying the killer doll, teen Andy Barclay is placed in a military school, and the spirit of Chucky returns to renew his quest and seek vengeance after being recreated from a mass of melted plastic.
